summary: Beta Bionics filed an 8-K reporting a press release about updated commercialization timeline for its Mint patch pump, now expected by end of Q2 2027 pending FDA clearance. No deal terms, no M&A, no activist event, no capital return, no restructuring, no tender offer. Filing is a routine operational update regarding regulatory and manufacturing progress. Nothing in the filing constitutes a special situation transaction or forced management change.
